title: Advanced Topics Practice 3
statement:
Module 5 (Advanced Topics) covers: html performance, html security, capstone: build a page. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 3: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (Capstone: Build a Page).
hints: Re-read the Capstone: Build a Page lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
